description.fallback: As Kakashi heads through the woods to Kannabi Bridge, he flinches in pain from his wound. Recalling Rin healing his wounds and Obito's steadfast decision to abandon the mission to save her, Kakashi begins to consider his choices. Meanwhile, Obito manages to locate the two Iwa-nin outside their cave.
